posts.author: rihan_baji
posts.text: Need help to build Intraday Scanner — Hey, this is Streak. It’s basically a no-code platform where you can build and test your trading strategies using indicators like EMA, RSI, MACD, etc. You can set your own conditions, backtest them and scan for stocks that match your setup. Basically, it helps you turn your trading idea into a proper rule-based strategy. You can check it out here and see how it works.
